[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Host-owned epic launches stop failing their planner agent[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]An approved epic whose host-owned `sase bead work` launch is still [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]running (or already succeeded) never marks its planner agent [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]FAILED, a planner-side SDD publication failure is reported as [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]exactly that, and a `sase dev update` source swap under a live [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]agent runner is prevented where it can be and named honestly where [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]it cannot.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Host-owned launches own their own outcome[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]attribution[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]attribution: stop converting a planner-side SDD store failure into [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`epic_launch_failed` when the approval response assigned launch [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ownership to the host, degrade to `epic_approved` with a recorded [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]publication error, and carry that degradation into the completion [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]notification instead of a bogus resume command.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Agent runners survive mid-run editable source swaps[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]skew_guard[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]skew_guard: preload the post-gate import surface once at agent-runner [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]start so a later `sase dev update` cannot tear a deferred import, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]snapshot the source revision the process booted against, and label [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]failures whose cause is an import error after a swap as a code swap [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rather than an unusable store.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Dev updates name the live runners they may tear[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]swap_visibility[dim] · [dim][/dim]after skew_guard[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]swap_visibility: register long-lived agent runners as advisory, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]non-blocking code-swap readers and surface them in `sase update` and the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ACE update preview, without ever letting an agent defer a source swap.[/#D7D7AF]
